children: Germany maritime investment firm's H1 revenue up 5.6% yr/yr, EBT up 34.1%
Company raised 2026 outlook for revenue and EBT
MPC Oceanic Group raises 2026 revenue outlook to EUR 50-53 mln from EUR 45-50 mln
Company lifts 2026 EBT guidance to EUR 30-33 mln from EUR 25-30 mln
Stronger outlook driven by H1 performance and expected contributions from project and co-investment business
MARITIME SERVICES - Co said industrial positioning and new products in maritime services drove recurring revenue growth
MARITIME INVESTMENT BUSINESS - Co said strong momentum in maritime investment business boosted transaction services revenue
CO-INVESTMENT PORTFOLIO - Co said continued strong earnings contributions from co-investment portfolio supported EBT growth
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the investment management & fund operators peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for MPC Muenchmeyer Petersen Capital AG is €8.50, about 61% above its September 2 closing price of €5.28
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
Sept 2 - DIW raises German economic growth forecasts as exports beat expectations
